slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 青云宗门，演武大典台。
暮春的风本该温煦柔和，今日却卷着山道微凉的清气，掠过数万弟子肃立的广场。青石铺就的大典台面如镜，一尘不染，两侧云柱高耸，悬着鎏金楹联，上方“鉴灵悟道”四个古字熠熠生辉，道韵流转，压得全场鸦雀无声。
一年一度的宗门灵根大典，是青云宗所有新晋弟子的命运分水岭。
修仙界以灵根定天赋，以根骨定前路。但凡能测出三纹以上灵根者，便可入内门、得师长亲传，从此踏青云、登大道；若无灵根，便是废体，终生与仙道无缘，只能沦为宗门杂役，耗尽岁月，碌碌无为。
广场数万弟子层层列队，人人身姿挺拔，眼底皆是藏不住的期待与紧张。有人忐忑不安，有人自信昂扬，所有人的目光，都死死锁定在高台中央那尊古朴厚重的鉴灵石碑上。
此碑传承千年，引天地灵气为用，可照修士本源，判灵根品级，从无差错。
高台之上，数位白衣长老端坐席位，神色肃穆，目光扫过下方弟子，威严自现。首席长老抬手轻压，嘈杂的私语声瞬间消散，整片广场落针可闻。
“继续。”
淡淡两个字落下，负责测灵的执事立刻躬身应声，高声念出下一位弟子姓名。
接连数十人上前，灵根纹路接连亮起。二纹、三纹、四纹灵光次第绽放，翠绿、湛蓝、赤红的灵韵升腾而起，引得台下阵阵惊呼。尤其是数位测出上品灵根的弟子，身姿挺拔，眉眼骄傲，下台时脊背挺直，接受着全场艳羡的目光。
在这人人争辉的大典之上，平庸，即是罪过。
更遑论，无灵根者。
“下一位，外门弟子——林寂。”
执事清朗的声音响彻广场，瞬间将所有人的注意力汇聚到队伍末尾那道单薄的身影上。
林寂缓步走出队列。
他身着一身洗得发白的粗布外门弟子服，布料粗糙，边角微微磨损，与周遭一众衣饰整洁的弟子相比，显得格格不入。身形清瘦，脊背却绷得笔直，未曾有半分佝偻。少年眉眼清俊干净，肤色是常年修炼、风吹日晒的浅白，一双眼瞳漆黑沉静，像是藏着深不见底的寒潭，无波无澜。
入宗三年，他始终是外门最不起眼的那一个。
无师承、无资源、无靠山，每日只能靠着宗门分发的微薄灵石，独自苦修，默默打磨体魄。旁人嘲讽他愚笨木讷，耗费三年光阴依旧毫无长进，他从不多言，只是日日早起晚归，从未懈怠半分。
他不信天命定人高低，只信勤能补拙。今日灵根大典，便是他唯一的翻身机会。
只要能测出灵根，他便能挣脱底层桎梏，真正踏上修仙大道。
林寂抬步踏上冰凉的青石台，步履平稳，不慌不忙，无视周遭悄然投来的打量目光。
可他刚站定，一道轻佻讥讽的笑声便骤然响起，打破了场上的肃穆。
“哈哈哈，居然真轮到这废物了。”
说话的是内门天才弟子赵辰，他一袭华丽锦袍，腰束玉带，身姿俊朗，天赋出众，是本届新晋弟子中最耀眼的存在，方才刚刚测出五纹上品金灵根，风头无两。
他斜倚在人群前方，眉眼满是轻蔑，居高临下地看着台上的林寂，语气极尽嘲讽：“三年苦修，连最基础的引气入体都堪堪不稳，我倒要看看，你能测出什么像样的灵根。别是块彻头彻尾的废骨头吧？”
话音落下，周遭立刻响起一片哄笑。
“赵师兄说得没错，这林寂就是外门垫底的废物。”
“三年毫无寸进，怕是天生无灵根，还硬要赖在宗门苦修，纯属浪费资源。”
“我赌他测灵毫无反应，直接沦为全宗笑柄！”
细碎的嘲讽声此起彼伏，密密麻麻落在耳边，像无数根细针轻轻扎刺。无数道戏谑、鄙夷、看热闹的目光死死钉在林寂身上，带着毫不掩饰的轻视与讥讽。
高台之上的长老们也微微蹙眉，看向林寂的眼神带着几分漠然的不耐。在修仙宗门，天赋便是一切，没有天赋的普通人，注定只能是底层陪衬。
林寂置若罔闻。
他垂着眼帘，长睫掩去眼底所有情绪，不辩解、不恼怒，抬手按在冰凉古朴的鉴灵石碑之上。掌心贴合碑面，微凉的石质触感顺着指尖蔓延全身。
content_en:
Qingyun Sect, martial arts ceremony stage.
The late spring wind should have been warm and gentle, but today it carried the cool air of the mountain road and passed by the square where tens of thousands of disciples stood in silence. The grand ceremony table paved with bluestone was like a mirror, spotless, with towering cloud pillars on both sides, and gilded couplets hanging on them. The four ancient characters "Jianling Ling Wu Tao" shined above, and the Taoist rhyme flowed, and the whole place was silent.
The annual sect spiritual root ceremony is a watershed in the fate of all new disciples of the Qingyun Sect.
In the world of immortality, one's spiritual roots determine one's talent, and one's bones determine the future. Anyone who can measure the spiritual roots of three lines or above can enter the inner sect, receive personal instructions from the master, and then walk on the clouds and ascend the great road. If there is no spiritual root, the body will be useless and will have no chance of immortality for life.
Tens of thousands of disciples lined up in the square, everyone stood tall and straight, and their eyes could not hide their anticipation and nervousness. Some people were uneasy, some were confident and high-spirited, and everyone's eyes were fixed on the simple and heavy spirit-appraisal stone tablet in the center of the high platform.
This stele has been passed down for thousands of years. It draws the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for use. It can judge the grade of spiritual root according to the monk's origin, and there is no mistake.
On the high platform, several elders in white were sitting in their seats with solemn expressions. Their eyes swept over the disciples below, showing their majesty. The chief elder raised his hand and pressed lightly, and the noisy whispers instantly dissipated, and the whole square could hear a needle drop.
"Continue."
As soon as the word "dilian" came out, the deacon in charge of soul testing immediately bowed and responded, loudly reading the name of the next disciple.
Dozens of people came forward one after another, and the spiritual root patterns lit up one after another. The second, third, and fourth lines of aura bloomed one after another, and the emerald green, azure blue, and red auras rose up, causing the audience to exclaim. In particular, the disciples who had high-grade spiritual roots measured tall and tall, with proud eyebrows and straight backs when they came off the stage, received the envious gazes of the audience.
In this grand ceremony where everyone strives for glory, mediocrity is a sin.
Not to mention those without spiritual roots.
"The next one is Lin Ji, an outer disciple."
The deacon's clear voice echoed through the square, instantly focusing everyone's attention on the thin figure at the end of the line.
Lin Ji walked out of the queue slowly.
He was wearing an outer disciple's uniform of coarse cloth that had been washed white. The fabric was rough and the edges were slightly frayed. He looked out of place compared to the neatly dressed disciples around him. His body is thin, but his back is straight and not even rickets. The young man's eyebrows are clean and handsome, his complexion is light white due to years of practice and exposure to wind and sun, and his eyes are dark and calm, as if hiding a bottomless cold pool, without waves or waves.
Three years after joining the sect, he has always been the most inconspicuous one in the outer sect.
With no teacher, no resources, and no backer, he could only rely on the meager spiritual stones distributed by the sect every day to practice hard alone and silently polish his body. Others ridiculed him for being stupid and dull, and he still made no progress after spending three years. He never said much, but got up early and came home late every day, never slacking off.
He does not believe that fate determines a person's level, but only believes that hard work can make up for his weakness. Today's Spiritual Root Ceremony is his only chance to turn around.
As long as he can detect his spiritual roots, he can break free from the shackles of the bottom and truly embark on the path of cultivating immortality.
Lin Ji stepped onto the cold bluestone platform, walking steadily and unhurriedly, ignoring the quietly appraising glances from around her.
But as soon as he stood still, a frivolous and sarcastic laughter suddenly sounded, breaking the solemnity on the field.
"Hahaha, it's actually this waste's turn."
The one who spoke was Zhao Chen, a genius disciple of the inner sect. He was dressed in a gorgeous brocade robe, with a jade belt around his waist. He had a handsome figure and outstanding talent. He was the most dazzling being among the new disciples of this year. He had just tested the five-line high-grade golden spiritual root, and he was unparalleled in the limelight.
He was leaning in front of the crowd, his eyebrows full of contempt, looking down at Lin Ji on the stage, and his tone was extremely mocking: "Three years of hard training, even the most basic way of introducing Qi into the body is unsteady. I want to see what decent spiritual roots you can detect. Don't be a complete useless bone, right?"
As soon as he finished speaking, there was laughter all around.
"Senior Brother Zhao is right, Lin Ji is the loser at the bottom of the outer sect."
"I haven't made any progress in three years. I'm afraid I was born without spiritual roots. I still insist on practicing hard in the sect. It's a waste of resources."
"I bet he didn't respond to the spirit test and became the laughing stock of the entire sect!"
Tiny sneers came one after another, falling densely on his ears, like countless thin needles pricking him gently. Countless looks of ridicule, disdain, and fun were fixed on Lin Ji, with undisguised contempt and ridicule.
The elders on the high platform also frowned slightly, looking at Lin Ji with a bit of indifferent impatience. In the Immortal Cultivation Sect, talent is everything. Ordinary people without talent are destined to only be the background of the bottom class.
Lin Ji turned a deaf ear.
He lowered his eyes, and his long eyelashes covered up all the emotions in his eyes. He did not defend himself or get angry. He raised his hand and pressed it on the cold and simple stone tablet of Jianling. The palm of the hand is pressed against the surface of the monument, and the cool stone touch spreads throughout the body along the fingertips.
